name: devmind-monorepo
description: DevMind Development Environment - Full Stack Application

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "Laravel,FastAPI,Proxy" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow" "pnpm run dev:laravel" "pnpm run dev:fastapi" "pnpm run dev:proxy"
scripts.dev:fastapi: cd fastAPI && venv\Scripts\activate && cd src && uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8005
scripts.dev:proxy: cd fastAPI && venv\Scripts\activate && cd src && set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 && litellm --config configllm.yaml --port 4000
scripts.setup: npm run setup:laravel && npm run setup:fastapi
scripts.setup:laravel: cd laravel && composer install && pnpm install && pnpm run build
scripts.setup:fastapi: cd fastAPI && python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:laravel && npm run test:fastapi
scripts.clean: npm run clean:laravel && npm run clean:fastapi
scripts.clean:laravel: cd laravel && rmdir /s /q node_modules vendor 2>nul & composer clear-cache

author: MohamedThabt
